description: What must never appear on the control channel, in v2 as in v1 (voice-control/sensitive.json). fake_secrets are the stand-ins the helper's tests sign in and join with: none may appear in any line either side writes, nor in any fixture here except the one conformance case that shows an unknown field named token being ignored. forbidden_field_fragments may not occur in the name of any field of any message of the protocol. A device name is not a secret, but it is owner-to-helper text: the helper never repeats it in an event.
